summary:
Fixed and verified — `test.sh` passes.

**The needle:** `CsvReader` decoded the input CSV as **ISO-8859-1**, but the file is **UTF-8** (e.g. `é` = bytes `c3 a9`). Each multibyte character was read as two separate Latin-1 chars (mojibake), then re-encoded to UTF-8 by the report writer, corrupting every international name.

**The fix** (`app/CsvReader.java`): decode the CSV as `StandardCharsets.UTF_8`, matching the UTF-8 report output so names round-trip cleanly. All 12 name checks now pass.
